name: Colby
siboNotes: Aged hard cheeses like Colby are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated. The aging process breaks down most lactose content.
preparationTips: Choose aged Colby over processed cheese products
Grate fresh for better melting in recipes
Store properly wrapped to prevent moisture loss
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
nutritionalHighlights: High in calcium for bone health
Provides phosphorus for teeth and bones
